name: William Brodhead
bio: a Representative from Michigan; born in Cleveland, Cuyahoga County, Ohio, September 12, 1941; graduated from St. Ignatius High School, Cleveland, Ohio, 1959; A.B., Wayne State University, Detroit, Mich., 1965; J.D., University of Michigan Law School, Ann Arbor, Mich., 1967; admitted to the Michigan Bar in 1968; lawyer, private practice; member of the Michigan state house of representatives, 1970; reelected in 1972; delegate to Michigan state Democratic conventions, 1968-1974; elected as a Democrat to the Ninety-fourth and to the three succeeding Congresses (January 3, 1975-January 3, 1983); was not a candidate for reelection to the Ninety-eighth Congress in 1982; resumed the practice of law; unsuccessful candidate for nomination to United States Senate in 1994.
